marketing_description: The DeWALT DW089CG Green Laser Level features a green beam laser for clear visibility and a 3-beam line laser to aid in 90-degree layout. This self-leveling laser level has a working range without detector of 30 ft and is accurate to +/-3.2 mm at 9.1 m. It also includes a built-in magnetic pivot bracket and a micro adjust knob for precise alignment of 90-degree intersecting lines.
